description: This file provides helper structures and functions for wizard steps, options, and type conversions related to a wizard interface in an application. It includes definition of WizardOption and functions to decode steps, parse options, and convert between AnyCodable values and native types.

classes.name: WizardOption
classes.description: A structure representing a selectable option in a wizard, including its value, label, and optional hint.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object, returning nil if decoding fails.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Converts an array of dictionaries into an array of WizardOption objects.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Returns a trimmed, lowercased string from an AnyCodable value if it is a string.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Extracts the 'type' string value from a WizardStep.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a string representation.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Returns an array of AnyCodable from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Checks equality between two AnyCodable values.
